build.sources: gitCommit plus the changes of the commit that adds or rewrites this metadata, rendered from that working tree before committing

comparison: Compared by tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp with G01's tolerance (6/255 per channel, at most 0.5% of the pixels) on this GPU and driver only.
description: Gate D golden of a handheld room (I6 step 6, ADR-0014 §6, style 5.5 and 14.5, concept panel 6): the esde/building fixture's gb room on the handheld floor under its cyan neon, its invented titles as handheld cartridges on lit walnut shelves and face-out in the two low counter showcases (lit inside, generic handhelds on stands behind the glass of their bases) and the featured wall shelf, stations (a generic handheld in a small lit vitrine on a pedestal) along the walls, the one-seat lounge chair on the sage rug, console-art posters; since the step's review the counters lined in ivory under brighter glass, their handhelds' displays lit, a card per empty slot, a warm cove along the side walls, posters high over the shelves, a handheld pictogram beside the neon; from the doorway (the room's doorway camera), the hero CRT's clip held at 1.0 s.

image.format: PNG, 8-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded as the window shows it

fixture.name: esde/building
